create_email_with_attachments: create an Email object with sender, recipients, subject, content, and file attachments
send_email_with_attachments: send an email to multiple recipients with a subject, content, and file attachment paths
list_emails_in_folder: list emails in the INBOX folder with an offset and limit for pagination
reply_to_email: reply to an email by its ID from the INBOX folder with new content
forward_email_to_recipients: forward an email from the INBOX folder to new recipients and save to SENT
